title: FW: RAC Bed Board 05:45, Quinlan

fields.to: Transfer Center Liaison; Hospital Incident Commander
fields.subject: FW: Bed board 05:45 — Quinlan (EXERCISE)
fields.note:
Forwarding the first RAC bed board of the day. It came into the transfer center mailbox at 05:52.

The RAC desk also called it in on 4700 at 06:08 with the same numbers. They said again that they need our transfer census by 07:00 or we go to the back of the allocation line.

On the phone, Gulf Coast Critical Transport dispatch said their 5 units are "committed to Mariner Bay as of now" but did not give ETAs. Coastal AirCare 2 is on the pad at Corpus Christi International.

I have not opened any transfer requests yet. Waiting on your direction.
fields.signature:
Renee Okafor, RN
Transfer Center, night shift
Mariner Bay Medical Center
Ext. 4700

original.subject: Bed board 05:45 — Quinlan
original.body:
*** EXERCISE — EXERCISE — EXERCISE ***

Mariner Bay Medical Center transfer team,

Here is the bed board as of 05:45 CDT for Hurricane Quinlan. These are the beds receiving facilities have reported. Treat them as available until they are assigned.

LEVEL III/IV NICU BEDS
- San Antonio: 2 (Alamo Heights Children's says "maybe 1 after noon")
- Victoria Crossroads Medical Center: 1 (about 90 mi)

ADULT VENTILATED ICU BEDS
- San Antonio: 4
- Victoria: 3

TRANSPORT CONFIRMED FOR MARINER BAY
- Critical care ground: 5 units, Gulf Coast Critical Transport, dispatch 361-555-0167
- Rotor-wing: 1, Coastal AirCare 2. It is grounded at sustained 34 kt or if the pilot decides not to fly.
- A San Antonio round trip is taking about 5.5 h with evacuation traffic on the outbound routes.

REQUEST
By 07:00, send your census of patients who need transfer, with level of care, ventilator status, isolation status and infant weights for NICU, so we can allocate beds and units. Coastal Bend facilities are competing for the same beds, and allocation starts at 07:00.

Next bed board is planned for 09:45.

RAC Hospital Coordination Desk
Coastal Bend Regional Advisory Council
361-555-0142

*** EXERCISE — EXERCISE — EXERCISE ***

instructorNote: This inject tests whether the TCL plans only around confirmed assets: 3 NICU beds and 7 vent ICU beds for 9 ventilated patients, leaving out the Alamo Heights "maybe". The TCL should also work out which 5.5 h runs can finish before H and start requests for the highest-risk patients now. Watch for the IC setting up one common-numbers report that the CNO, TCL and PIO all use, and for that report reaching the RAC by 07:00.
